NONE: › in stories for children, a creature like a little man with magical powers
（兒童故事裡有魔法的）小矮人
› often offensive a person who is much smaller than the usual size
› If one thing dwarfs another, it makes it seem small by comparison.
使…相形見絀；使…顯得矮小

example: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
You can grow dwarf conifers in pots on the patio.
你可以在陽臺上種些矮小的針葉樹盆栽。
The new skyscraper will dwarf all those near it.
新建的摩天大樓會讓周圍的建築都顯得很矮小。
This new crisis may well dwarf most that have gone before.
這場新的危機可能比以往的大多數危機都嚴重得多。

NONE: › a round mass of metal and rock or gas, moving around the Sun or another star, that is not large enough to be considered a planet. Dwarf planets in the solar system include Ceres, Pluto, and Eris.
